title: What was your first dream in mall world?
content: I vividly remember having my first dream when I was around 6 or 7, I was walking down the hallway in our old house and at the very end of the hallway was a door going to an attic space, in my dream though rather than it being the attic, it opened up into a huge book store. There was a glass ceiling and many levels to the store. I remember how real it was and ever since that night I am excited to dream, to explore. That was over 20 years ago. It kind of feels like that was my spawning point in mall world and from there I have been able to explore so much more over the years.
